name: nz_au
title: New Zealand and Australia compared
source: Stats NZ via RBNZ, Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS) and OECD
note: Unemployment, labour force participation, wage growth and household spending after inflation in New Zealand and Australia, quarterly from 2015. Rates are per cent; growth is the annual % change against the same quarter a year earlier. Australian monthly figures are averaged (rates) or added up (spending) to quarters. New Zealand wages are the labour cost index for all sectors; Australian wages are the private-sector wage price index. Spending is card spending in New Zealand and the ABS household spending indicator in Australia, each less its own CPI inflation.
